title: Young Boy on Boardwalk, 1948 Bradley Beach NJ B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic post-World War II black and white square snapshot depicting a 2.5-year-old boy standing on a wooden boardwalk at Bradley Beach, New Jersey, in July 1948. The child wears overall-style shorts with suspenders, white socks, and white shoes while holding onto a metal pipe guardrail. In the background, sunbathers enjoy the sandy shore and ocean under clear skies, capturing the quintessential mid-century American seaside family vacation atmosphere.
